79: Four things decide it, and we check them before quoting: whether traffic lanes are flattened, whether seams have opened, whether the backing has gone brittle, and whether pet smell survived a professional cleaning. Any one of those means replacement. In plenty of Gleneagle and Smokey Point houses none of them apply — the carpet is only loose and rippled — and that's a $99-per-room stretch.
83: Around here the problem is mud as often as accidents — dogs off a wet acre, boots off the same. The build is identical either way: a moisture-barrier pad below, sealed-backed solution-dyed nylon above. Nothing reaches the subfloor, where odor turns permanent, and the color is locked into the fiber itself, so diluted bleach won't fade it. The barrier pad runs $0.65 per square foot and up, and pet-focused samples ride along on every visit.
85: Pad first, since that's the piece people miss: some mills void coverage when their carpet sits on the wrong grade of pad, which is why all three ride along in the van. It comes up most on Smokey Point starter homes still running their original builder pad. Otherwise: the mill covers wear and stain, usually 10 to 25 years by grade, and OC Flooring's 1-year workmanship warranty covers the install. Both print on your written quote.
